en.summary: Gate's event for returning CFD traders (you've traded CFDs before but not in the 7 days before the start), running November 12, 2026, 10:00 – November 26, 2026, 09:00 (UTC). You can combine a 200 USDx CFD Position Voucher, up to 586 USDT for volume tiers and up to 100 USDT loss compensation — up to 686 USDT plus the voucher, first come, first served while supplies last.
steps: Check you qualify: you have traded CFDs before (contracts for difference — trades on the price of stocks, gold etc. without owning the asset) and made no CFD trades in the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before the event starts.
Complete Identity Verification (KYC) on Gate — required before you select [Join Now].
Select [Join Now] on the event page. Only trading after you register counts. Participation is unavailable in some regions, including the UK.
Event 1: reach at least 200 USDx cumulative CFD trading volume to get a 200 USDx CFD Position Voucher (first 2,000 users).
Event 2: reach CFD volume tiers of 100,000 / 2,000,000 / 20,000,000 / 65,000,000 USDx before November 26, 2026, 09:00 (UTC).
Event 3 only applies if you're already losing: if your realized CFD net losses reach 100 USDx, you may be among the first 100 users to qualify for compensation. Don't lose money on purpose.

payout.when: Events 1 and 2: credited automatically as soon as you complete the task, while supplies last. Event 3: within 14 business days after the event ends and the data review is complete. No claim deadline is mentioned. If you get nothing, rewards ran out or you didn't meet the requirements.
payout.form: Event 1: a 200 USDx CFD Position Voucher — for CFD trading, not cash. Event 2: USDT spot tokens: 100,000 USDx → 1 USDT (3,000 slots); 2,000,000 USDx → 5 USDT (1,000 slots); 20,000,000 USDx → 80 USDT (100 slots); 65,000,000 USDx → 500 USDT (8 slots); tiers combine up to 586 USDT, pool 20,000 USDT. Event 3: USDT spot tokens equal to your final net loss, up to 100 USDT, pool 10,000 USDT.
payout.how: Automatic, no manual claim. Events 2 and 3 are paid as 'USDT spot tokens' — the rules mention no lock-up or withdrawal limit. They don't say where the voucher appears; check vouchers and rewards in your Gate account.

watch: Returning traders only: if you traded CFDs in the 7 days before the start, or never traded CFDs, you don't qualify.
KYC first, then [Join Now]: trading before registration doesn't count. Volume = buy volume + sell volume.
Few slots, first come, first served: Event 1 — first 2,000; Event 2 — 3,000 / 1,000 / 100 / 8 slots; Event 3 — first 100.

Event 3 is not insurance: only the first 100 to reach ≥100 USDx net loss; max 100 USDT; only positions opened and closed during the event after registering count, including trading and overnight fees; you must still be at a net loss when the event ends. Losses above 100 USDT are not covered.
Huge volume tiers: 65,000,000 USDx for 500 USDT — trading and overnight fees on that volume can exceed the reward.
If you join several Gate events of the same type at once, you get rewards from only one.
Sub-accounts are ineligible; several accounts verified under one identity count as one; volume inflation and self-trading are banned; market makers, companies and institutions can't join.
Gate TradFi may be restricted in some jurisdictions, and CFDs carry leverage, volatility and liquidity risk. Read the CFD Service Agreement and Risk Disclosure Statement.

faq.a: It's the unit Gate uses for CFD amounts in this event — volume, the voucher and losses. The rules don't explain it further. Event 2 and 3 rewards are paid in USDT.

faq.q: I traded CFDs 3 days before November 12. Can I join?
faq.a: No. You must have made no CFD trades in the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before the event starts.

faq.q: Can I get all three rewards?
faq.a: Yes, rewards can be combined, as long as you make it into each event's slot limit.

It equals your final net loss on positions opened and closed during the event after registering, including trading and overnight fees. Gate's calculation is final; the cap is 100 USDT. If you're in profit at the end, there's no compensation.

faq.q: I didn't receive a reward. What does that mean?
faq.a: Per the rules, the rewards ran out or you didn't meet the requirements.

faq.q: Can I withdraw the USDT rewards?
faq.a: The rules call them 'USDT spot tokens' and mention no withdrawal limits. The 200 USDx CFD voucher is not money — it's a trading coupon.
